title: Public E2E Verification after ODPT CSP Unblock + OS Wiring Fix
verdict: CRITICAL P0 BUG FOUND AND FIXED: line-operation-systems.js was never loaded by any HTML page

discovered_issues.description: data/core/line-operation-systems.js was created in 3.68 but never added to any HTML script tag. window.LineOperationSystems was undefined, causing LPS.getDisplayOrder() to silently fall back to alphabetical ordering.
discovered_issues.impact: OS ordering (3.69-3.71) was NOT working on public pages despite all CI checks passing
discovered_issues.fix: Added <script src='../data/core/line-operation-systems.js'> before line-presentation-service.js in realtime.html and trains.html

L0_deployed_csp.details: CSP includes api-challenge.odpt.org and api.odpt.org in both realtime.html and trains.html

L1_asset_loading.details: All 10 JS assets + style.css return HTTP 200

L2_odpt_api.details: JR-East: 392 items, TokyoMetro: 1000 items, Toei: 1000 items, Keikyu: 60 items, Seibu: 0 items (empty timetable - expected)

L3_data_integrity.details: Stations=509, Lines=156, name_map=1703. DataState.STATUS_META includes no_odpt. DataFusion has LINE_TO_OPERATOR, fuseAll, 30s interval.

L4_user_tasks.details: Home: from/to inputs + search button + route-search.js present. Realtime: all scripts loaded in correct order. Trains: OS wiring now fixed. History: history.js + db-loader.js loaded. Tourism: sightseeing.js + tourism-proximity.js loaded.

L5_interaction.details: Filter buttons, modal, language switcher all structurally present. DataFusion subscribes to updates.

L6_mobile.details: All pages have viewport meta tag. No horizontal overflow detected in structure.

L7_consistency.details: All 5 pages use same db-loader.js, translations.js, common.js, lang-init.js chain.

L8_industry.details: OS ordering now active. JR-East lines ordered per 3.69 rules. Branch lines (Ome, Itsukaichi) shown as standalone.

L9_product.details: Core product functional. One P2 note: status.no_odpt translation key missing from all 4 languages (shows raw 'no_odpt' label). Data segment durations still stub-based (P3 DATA-BLOCKED per 3.74).

i18n_findings.note: P2 issue - no_odpt label shows raw key. Not blocking.
